tooltip.en-US: See through the eyes of other players
tooltip.zh-Hans: 通过其他玩家的眼睛观察

tooltip.en-US:
Summons a friendly rainbow boulder to roll after you
'This rock is poppin'!'
tooltip.zh-Hans:
召唤一个友好的彩虹巨石跟在你身后滚动
“这块石头炫爆了！”

tooltip.en-US: 'Believe in yourself, and value others. Both are blessings.'
tooltip.zh-Hans: “相信自己，珍视他人。二者皆是福泽。”

tooltip.en-US: 'Draw wisdom from many places, lest it become stale.'
tooltip.zh-Hans: “博采众长汲取智慧，否则它将停滞不前。”

tooltip.en-US: 'True humility is the only antidote to shame.'
tooltip.zh-Hans: “真正的谦卑，是治愈羞耻的唯一解药。”

{$CommonItemTooltip.FlightAndSlowfall}
“每遇挫折，便重新开始...且变得更明智。”

tooltip.en-US:
Can be activated with the right materials
'At every setback, begin again... wiser.'
tooltip.zh-Hans:
可用合适的材料激活
每遇挫折，便重新开始...且变得更明智。

tooltip.en-US:
Grants the user an air of a pixie
'Great idea, Sprite! Too bad it’s terrible'
tooltip.zh-Hans:
赋予使用者妖精般的气质
好主意，小精灵！可惜太糟糕了

tooltip.en-US:
Summons Cattiva to fight for you
A lovely pal that also helps your mining efforts
{InputTrigger_InteractWithTile} to pet it!
tooltip.zh-Hans:
召唤捣蛋猫来为你而战
一位可爱的伙伴，还能帮你挖矿
{InputTrigger_InteractWithTile}来爱抚它！

tooltip.en-US:
Summons Foxparks to fight for you
{InputTrigger_UseOrAttack} to use Foxparks' Huggy Fire skill, shooting flames!
{InputTrigger_InteractWithTile} to pet it!
tooltip.zh-Hans:
召唤火绒狐为你而战
按{InputTrigger_UseOrAttack}施展火绒狐的“拥抱烈焰”技能，喷射火焰！
按{InputTrigger_InteractWithTile}抚摸它！

tooltip.en-US:
Summons Chillet for a ride!
Empowers your attacks while mounted.
Double tap a direction to use Rocket Slam!
{InputTrigger_InteractWithTile} to pet it!
tooltip.zh-Hans:
召唤疾旋鼬作为你的坐骑！
在骑乘期间强化你的攻击力。
双击一个方向可使用火箭重击！
{InputTrigger_InteractWithTile}来爱抚它！

tooltip.en-US:
Summons Chillet Ignis for a ride!
Empowers your attacks while mounted.
Double tap a direction to use Rocket Slam!
{InputTrigger_InteractWithTile} to pet it!
tooltip.zh-Hans:
召唤疾旋火鼬作为你的坐骑！
在骑乘期间强化你的攻击力。
双击一个方向可使用火箭重击！
{InputTrigger_InteractWithTile}来爱抚它！

tooltip.en-US:
Summons Digtoise to help mining!
{InputTrigger_UseOrAttack} to direct Digtoise
{InputTrigger_InteractWithTile} away to recall Digtoise
{InputTrigger_InteractWithTile} to pet it!
tooltip.zh-Hans:
召唤碎岩龟来帮助挖矿！
{InputTrigger_UseOrAttack}来引导碎岩龟
{InputTrigger_InteractWithTile}远处来召回碎岩龟
{InputTrigger_InteractWithTile}来爱抚它！

tooltip.en-US:

Whip crack can ignite enemies

3点召唤标记伤害
